terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.t1: Memberships can be upgraded or cancelled at any time; however, payments are non-refundable.
terms.t2: If a service issue occurs due to the company’s fault, a refund or compensation may be provided at the company’s discretion.
terms.t3: For annual plans, any price increase during the active subscription period will not apply. Revised pricing will take effect only after the current plan expires.
terms.t4: Membership benefits are valid only during the active subscription period.
terms.t5: Unused meals or benefits do not carry forward after plan expiry.
terms.t6: The company reserves the right to modify menu items, delivery availability, or service areas.
terms.t7: Misuse of membership benefits may result in suspension or termination without refund.
